Badge.name: size
Badge.description:
Type/padding scale. `default` is the historical 2px/8px pill; `sm` is the
denser chip for table cells and dense stat rows.

Badge.name: dot
Badge.description:
Render a leading status dot, tinted from the variant. The dot is
`aria-hidden` — the label carries the meaning, so a label is required
(or an explicit `aria-label` if you render a dot with no text).

Badge.name: pulse
Badge.description:
Gently pulse the status dot to draw attention to a live/changing state.
Implies `dot`. Frozen under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Card.name: variant
Card.description: Surface treatment. Defaults to the raised bordered card.

Card.name: padding
Card.description: Padding density off the `--space-*` ladder. Defaults to `--space-5` (20px).

Card.name: radius
Card.description: Corner radius off the `--radius-*` ladder. Defaults to `--radius-lg`.

Icon.name: brand
Icon.description: Render a `brand:` glyph in its official color instead of `currentColor`. No-op on stroke glyphs.

Icon.name: title
Icon.description:
Accessible label. When set, the icon is exposed to assistive tech as an
image with this name; when omitted, the icon is `aria-hidden` (decorative).

Progress.name: valueText
Progress.description: Free-form readout replacing the generated percent, e.g. "1:23 / 4:56".

Progress.name: segments
Progress.description:
Stacked bands, rendered left to right. Supersedes `value` and
`indeterminate`. Values are percentages of the track; if they sum past 100
every band is scaled down proportionally so the stack still fills exactly
one track (nothing is clipped or dropped) and the track gets
`data-overflow="true"`.

ChartFrame.name: title
ChartFrame.description: Header heading. Omit (with subtitle and actions) to drop the header row.

ChartFrame.name: actions
ChartFrame.description: Right-aligned header controls — a period selector, a menu, a legend toggle.

ChartFrame.name: footer
ChartFrame.description: Legend or source note rendered under the plot.

ChartFrame.name: height
ChartFrame.description: Plot height in px, or `'auto'` to derive it from `rowCount`. Default 280.

ChartFrame.name: rowCount
ChartFrame.description: Rows in the chart. Drives the height when `height="auto"`. Default 0.

ChartFrame.name: rowHeight
ChartFrame.description: Px per row in `'auto'` mode. Default 32.

ChartFrame.name: minHeight
ChartFrame.description: Floor for the resolved height. Default 200.

ChartFrame.name: maxHeight
ChartFrame.description: Ceiling for the resolved height. Default 560.

ChartFrame.name: padding
ChartFrame.description: Shell padding scale. `'none'` lets the plot bleed to the card edge.

DataTable.name: rows
DataTable.description: The rows to render, in the order they should appear.

DataTable.name: getRowKey
DataTable.description:
Stable React key per row. Required on purpose: keying by array index
silently corrupts state when rows are sorted, filtered or paginated.

DataTable.name: sort
DataTable.description: Controlled sort state, or `null`/omitted for unsorted.

DataTable.name: onSortChange
DataTable.description: Called with the next sort state when a sort button is activated.

DataTable.name: empty
DataTable.description: Shown in a full-width cell when `rows` is empty and not loading.

DataTable.name: loading
DataTable.description: Replace the body with shimmering `Skeleton` rows.

DataTable.name: loadingRows
DataTable.description: How many skeleton rows to render while `loading`. Default 4.

DataTable.name: maxHeight
DataTable.description: Max height of the scroll region; the head stays sticky above it.

DataTable.name: containerClassName
DataTable.description: Class for the scroll container (the element `maxHeight` constrains).

StatCard.name: bare
StatCard.description: Drop the card shell (border, background, elevation), keep the padding.

StatGrid.name: columns
StatGrid.description: Track count, or `'auto'` for a responsive auto-fit grid. Default `'auto'`.

StatGrid.name: minItemWidth
StatGrid.description: Minimum auto-fit track width — a number is px. Only used when `columns="auto"`. Default `180`.

StatGrid.name: gap
StatGrid.description: Gutter step. Ignored when `divided` (separators replace the gutter). Default `'md'`.

StatGrid.name: divided
StatGrid.description: Hairline separators between cells instead of gutters.

Table.name: containerClassName
Table.description: Class for the scroll container — the element `maxHeight` constrains.

Tabs.name: overflow
Tabs.description: `wrap` (default) preserves the multi-row wrap; `scroll` scrolls one row.

CategoryBreakdown.name: iconOverrides
CategoryBreakdown.description: App-supplied category→icon map applied to every row's pill.

CategoryPill.name: icon
CategoryPill.description: Raw SVG geometry to render instead of any inferred/registry glyph.

CategoryPill.name: iconName
CategoryPill.description: A glyph from the icon registry by name — e.g. an app's stored category icon.

CategoryPill.name: overrides
CategoryPill.description: App-supplied category→icon map; wins over keyword inference.

ImportDropzone.name: accept
ImportDropzone.description: Accepted types, `accept`-attribute syntax. Enforced on drop as well as on browse.

ImportDropzone.name: multiple
ImportDropzone.description: Allow more than one file per selection.

ImportDropzone.name: maxSize
ImportDropzone.description: Hard byte ceiling, enforced on both intake paths. Omit for no limit.

ImportDropzone.name: onFile
ImportDropzone.description: Legacy singular callback — receives the first accepted file. Still supported.

ImportDropzone.name: onFiles
ImportDropzone.description: Receives every accepted file from a selection.

ImportDropzone.name: onError
ImportDropzone.description: Receives anything `accept`/`maxSize` turned away, from either intake path.

ImportDropzone.name: hint
ImportDropzone.defaultValue: CSV, OFX or QFX · up to 10MB
ImportDropzone.description: Secondary line under the primary copy.

ImportDropzone.name: label
ImportDropzone.description: Primary copy. Defaults to the statement-import wording.

ImportDropzone.name: children
ImportDropzone.description: Alias for `label`, for callers who prefer a child.

ImportDropzone.name: replaceLabel
ImportDropzone.description: The replace affordance shown next to the size once a file is chosen.

ImportDropzone.name: files
ImportDropzone.description: Controlled selection. Passing this (including `[]`/`null`) takes ownership.

ImportDropzone.name: disabled
ImportDropzone.description: Refuse both intake paths and dim the surface.

MoneyInput.name: onValueChange
MoneyInput.type: ((value: number | null, raw: string) => void) | undefined

PeriodSelector.name: custom
PeriodSelector.type: { from?: string | undefined; to?: string | undefined; } | undefined

PeriodSelector.name: onCustomChange
PeriodSelector.type: ((range: { from?: string | undefined; to?: string | undefined; }) => void) | undefined

PeriodSelector.name: presets
PeriodSelector.defaultValue:
[
  { value: 'this-month', label: 'This month' },
  { value: 'last-30', label: 'Last 30 days' },
  { value: 'this-quarter', label: 'This quarter' },
  { value: 'ytd', label: 'Year to date' },
  { value: 'this-year', label: 'This year' },
  { value: 'custom', label: 'Custom range' },
]

Combobox.name: name
Combobox.description: Form control name — forwarded to the inner search `<input>`.

Field.name: label
Field.description: Label content. Omit for a field that is labelled some other way.

Field.name: hint
Field.description: Help text below the control. Hidden while `error` is set.

Field.name: error
Field.description: Error text below the control. Takes precedence over `hint`.

Field.name: required
Field.description: Marks the control `aria-required` and prints the label's `*`.

Field.name: id
Field.description: Control id. Generated when omitted (a child's own `id` wins over both).

Input.name: leadingIcon
Input.description: Node rendered inside the field's left edge. Decorative (`aria-hidden`).

Input.name: trailingIcon
Input.description: Node rendered inside the field's right edge. Decorative (`aria-hidden`).

Input.name: clearable
Input.description:
Render a clear button once the field has a value. It is a real `<button>`
with an accessible name, and is disabled (so out of the tab order) while
there is nothing to clear.

Input.name: onClear
Input.description: Called after the clear button is pressed. Controlled callers clear here.

Input.name: clearLabel
Input.description: Accessible name for the clear button.

Slider.name: name
Slider.description: Form control name — forwarded to the inner `input[type=range]`.

UploadButton.name: accept
UploadButton.description: `accept` attribute for the input, e.g. `.csv,.ofx` or `audio/*`.

UploadButton.name: multiple
UploadButton.description: Allow picking more than one file.

UploadButton.name: maxSize
UploadButton.description: Hard byte ceiling; files over it are rejected instead of handed over.

UploadButton.name: onFiles
UploadButton.description: Called with the accepted files after every selection.

UploadButton.name: loading
UploadButton.description: Upload in flight — disables the control and sets `aria-busy`.

UploadButton.name: icon
UploadButton.description: Leading node, swapped for a Spinner while `loading`. Icons are nodes — no icon dep.

UploadButton.name: loadingLabel
UploadButton.description: Label shown while `loading`; falls back to `children`.

UploadButton.name: inputRef
UploadButton.description: Escape hatch onto the hidden input (e.g. to clear it imperatively).

UploadButton.name: inputProps
UploadButton.description: Extra attributes for the hidden input.

ConfirmDialog.name: tone
ConfirmDialog.description:
`destructive` tints the confirm button and — deliberately — focuses Cancel
on open, so a reflexive Enter cannot delete anything.

ConfirmDialog.name: onConfirm
ConfirmDialog.description:
The action. May return a promise: the confirm button goes into a pending
state, both buttons disable, Escape and scrim clicks stop closing, and the
dialog stays open until it settles. A rejection is surfaced (see
`onError`), never swallowed, and the dialog stays open so the user can retry.

ConfirmDialog.name: onClose
ConfirmDialog.description: Called after a successful confirm, after cancel, and on Escape/scrim.

ConfirmDialog.name: onError
ConfirmDialog.description:
Handles a rejected/throwing `onConfirm`. Without it the error is re-thrown
during render so the nearest error boundary sees it rather than it
vanishing into a dead promise.

ConfirmDialog.name: pending
ConfirmDialog.description: Force the pending state (for a confirm driven by external state).

ConfirmDialog.name: children
ConfirmDialog.description: Extra detail rendered in the dialog body above the actions.

Dialog.name: onClose
Dialog.description: Fires on Escape (when topmost), scrim click, and nothing else.

Dialog.name: closeOnEscape
Dialog.description: `false` keeps the dialog open on Escape (it still swallows the key).

Dialog.name: closeOnOverlayClick
Dialog.description: `false` keeps the dialog open when the scrim is clicked.

Dialog.name: portal
Dialog.description: `false` renders in place in the React tree instead of a portal.

Dialog.name: lockScroll
Dialog.description: `false` leaves `document.body` scrollable while the dialog is open.

Dialog.name: initialFocus
Dialog.description: Element to focus on open. Defaults to the first focusable child.

Toast.name: role
Toast.description:
ARIA role. Derived from `variant` when omitted: `'alert'` for `error`,
`'status'` otherwise. Override to force one either way.

Toast.name: aria-live
Toast.description:
Live-region politeness. Derived from `variant` when omitted: `'assertive'`
for `error`, `'polite'` otherwise. Override to force one either way.

Toaster.name: position
Toaster.description: Corner or edge to pin the stack to. Default `'bottom-right'`.

Toaster.name: max
Toaster.description: Most toasts shown at once; the rest collapse into a `+N more` count. `0` shows all. Default `3`.

Toaster.name: gap
Toaster.description: Space between stacked toasts, in px. Default `10`.

Toaster.name: duration
Toaster.description: Default auto-dismiss in ms for toasts that don't set their own. Default `5000`.
